name: rpm-app-project
description: Plataforma Integral de Gestión de Rankings de Pádel — Microfrontends con Native Federation

scripts.start: concurrently -n "API,APP,ADMIN,RANKINGS,TEAMS,USERS,LIVE" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold,blue.bold,magenta.bold,red.bold,white.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "ng serve rpm-app" "ng serve rpm-admin" "ng serve rpm-rankings" "ng serve rpm-teams" "ng serve rpm-users" "ng serve rpm-live"
scripts.start:network: concurrently -n "API,APP,ADMIN,RANKINGS,TEAMS,USERS,LIVE" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold,blue.bold,magenta.bold,red.bold,white.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "ng serve rpm-app" "ng serve rpm-admin" "ng serve rpm-rankings" "ng serve rpm-teams" "ng serve rpm-users" "ng serve rpm-live"
scripts.build: npx ng build rpm-admin && npx ng build rpm-rankings && npx ng build rpm-teams && npx ng build rpm-users && npx ng build rpm-live && npx ng build rpm-app
scripts.build:all: npx ng build rpm-admin && npx ng build rpm-rankings && npx ng build rpm-teams && npx ng build rpm-users && npx ng build rpm-live && npx ng build rpm-app
